title: Sanctuary Guardian (WHAT)
blurb: The Sanctuary Guardian sting — the Earthbound boss music burst that meme culture attached to moments of pure 'WHAT.' Something absurd is said, the image freezes, this brass blast hits. It's the definitive caption-meme sound: maximum alarm at minimum provocation. One of the most recognizable two seconds in meme editing, straight from a 1994 SNES game.
origin: From Earthbound's Sanctuary Guardian boss theme, meme-ified for shocked captions.
